beats.text: I lost $18,000 because of one missing contract.
beats.label: HOOK

beats.text: Here is the exact clause I now put in every single contract I send, and honestly it has changed the way that I think about getting paid for the work that I do every single month.
beats.label: MID

beats.text: Section 4. Payment on delivery, not on approval.
Approval is a feeling. Delivery is a date.
That one word change is worth $18,000 to me.
beats.label: CTA

notes: Beat(s) 2 run past 4s. Either split the line or change what is on screen inside it. A static frame is where people leave.
Loops: the last beat repeats "$18,000" from the hook. Second watches are free reach.
4.9s under target. Either add 13 words or shoot it short. Short is usually right.
